title: Verify Technician cannot order a part on a work order line
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Technician role. (this role has Order Parts OFF).
At least one work order exists that contains labor and part lines with prices entered.
steps:
1. Open a work order line and open the parts actions.
2. Look for an Order option; if present, click it.
expected: Ordering a part is BLOCKED: the Order action is hidden/disabled or returns a permission error.
